category_edits.rationale: Blend 90% of the existing negative-score-weighted pairwise loss with 10% uniform pairwise loss. This gives every valid training pair direct ranking supervision while preserving sampling, architecture, scoring, optimizer, and training settings.

change_summary: Change only the learning objective to a 90/10 weighted/uniform pairwise-loss blend using existing scores. Predictor and checkpoint formats remain compatible.
